Description: Differences the adoption step (M1-03, owner decisions of 2026-10-18) is expected to make. Adoption also runs every fork migration step, so the Open Dental 25.4 and 26.1 schema changes (M2-01) are listed too, table by table and column by column. Everything else must be identical before and after adoption. Table, Column and Name accept * wildcards. A report can only allow preference, documentmisc, securitylog, securityloghash, displayreport, grouppermission, codegroup and toolbutitem as whole tables, the three columns whose values the 25.4 and 26.1 steps change (claimpayment.Note, insverify and insverifyhist.DateLastAssigned) and program.Enabled (the DXC Patient Credit Score step) as whole columns, and a new table or column without its values; AdoptionValidation adopt checks all of them row by row against the original (AdoptionRowCheck: only the changes migration-preview lists, new tables empty, new columns at their defaults), and the runbook's step 6.1 reads that check. updatehistory has no rule: adoption does not touch it. A CHECKSUM TABLE change is allowed only with another difference in its table (ReportComparer), never by a rule.

Adoption rehashes every row with the fork's HMAC (risk R2, item 6).

Adoption deletes Open Dental's UpdateFiles rows (checked row by row by adopt).

Follows securitylog (checked row by row by adopt: rows only added).

The fork migration renames the report rows Open Dental wrote under names this program does not know (step 2026101971), and adds the row of the Open Dental 25.4 UDS+ report after the FQHC Dental Sealant Measure, moving the later Public Health rows down one place (step 2026110103, M2-UDS); adding a row changes every column checksum, so only a whole-table rule can allow it (checked row by row by adopt: only the renames, the added row and the moves migration-preview lists, with the planned values).

The fork migration (step 2026102501, M2-02) splits the 25.4 blockout permission: Open Dental 25.3 PhoneExtension grants move from 272 to 274, and BlockoutAdd and BlockoutDelete go to every user group with a Blockouts grant; its UDS+ report row step (2026110103, M2-UDS) gives the user groups that may run the FQHC Dental Sealant Measure the Reports permission for the new row (checked row by row by adopt: only the moves and grants migration-preview lists).

The fork migration's Insurance History step (2026110104, M2-HIST) marks the code group of each history category whose InsHist*Codes preference has a value Show In History (with its History Proc Code and, for the perio quadrants, Perio Four Quadrants), appends the preference's codes the group lacks to its ProcCodes, and adds a group for a category that has none; an added row changes every column checksum, so only a whole-table rule can allow it (checked row by row by adopt: only the groups migration-preview lists, ProcCodes and the history columns only, and the added groups with the planned values).

The fork migration's DXC Patient Credit Score step (2026110101, B-SHELL) disables that discontinued program link on every database, an Open Dental 25.3.48 one included; the row and its text stay (checked row by row by adopt: only the DXC rows migration-preview lists change, Enabled only, to 0; no other program row or column changes).

The same step (2026110101, B-SHELL) deletes the toolbar buttons of the DXC Patient Credit Score link; a deleted row changes every column checksum, so only a whole-table rule can allow it (checked row by row by adopt: only the buttons migration-preview lists are deleted; no other row changes, is added or goes).
